programme.desc: Juan está convencido de que es una mujer, su esposa, Liscar, le exige que vaya a terapia. Ariana tiene muchas cucarachas en su casa y como su amiga Claudia les tiene miedo, la demanda.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Ivonne alteró la letra pequeña de un contrato para pagar menos, el prestamista lo descubre y la demanda. Acusan a Nicole de ser una mala influencia que arruina la carrera de un cantante urbano.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Historia de una prosti; Estafa universitaria
programme.desc: Mía estudia periodismo y gana un concurso literario, pero no le dan el premio porque el relato es sobre su vida como prostituta. Michel se disfraza de Kory y presenta un examen para ayudarla.

programme.title: Enemigo íntimo
programme.desc: Instalada en su nuevo centro de operaciones en Las Dunas, Roxana ordena que le traigan a la "Puma", pero no aparece. Ferrer está indignado, cree que todo es un circo del gobierno de turno.

programme.title: Enemigo íntimo
programme.desc: La lealtad es parte del plan de reclutamiento de Rodiles para su empresa y una revuelta lo inicia. Ferrer le dice que podrá engañar a todos, a la prensa y al gobierno; pero a él, no.

programme.title: 100 días para enamorarnos
programme.desc: Remedios, Constanza, Plutarco y Emiliano brindan por su amistad de 20 años. Aurora, cansada de estar en el anonimato, tiene algo que decirles y una decisión que tomar. Jimena tiene que saberlo.

programme.title: 100 días para enamorarnos
programme.sub-title: Sin el pan y sin la torta
programme.desc: La noche de sexo de Luis y Jimena pone en duda el acuerdo de 100 días. Aunque intentan decirle la verdad, ella está ciega, sorda y muda. Marcelo la pasa muy mal, al descuidar su teléfono.

programme.title: Juego de villanos
programme.desc: Dieciocho villanos icónicos compiten por el título de "El Emperador de los Villanos" y 200 mil dólares. Entre desafíos, inmunidades, alianzas y traiciones, solo uno alcanza la cima.

programme.title: Falsa identidad
programme.sub-title: Nueva vida de Isabel y Diego
programme.desc: Piensan en un futuro mejor y sin problemas, Isabel y Diego están listos para disfrutar en familia. Pero un enemigo desquiciado y con sed de venganza está al acecho. Circe busca escapar.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Me dejaste colgada; Pancho y Romeo
programme.desc: Ivandra queda colgada en una pared de escalar, cuando John deja de sujetarla, ella sufre daños en la muñeca. Los "Pony Play" se disfrazan y Pancho demanda a su esposa por maltrato animal.

programme.title: Victoria

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Dormir o comer; Amor a la muerte
programme.desc: Le dan somníferos para que se mantenga delgada y pueda modelar. Practicaba sexo extremo con la hermana de su esposa, ella muere y le deja una herencia que no puede cobrar por estar involucrado.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: Celebrity Name Game
programme.desc: Early on in game shows, when stars took part, they aided players -- to guess secret words on "Password," for instance. Now they're helping them guess names of VIPs in host Craig Ferguson's four-round competition set in a party atmosphere. The celebrity/contestant pairs must identify the famous -- actors, athletes, politicians, cartoon characters, etc. -- based on improvised clues for a chance to win $20,000. The celebrity connection extends behind the cameras; actors Courteney Cox and David Arquette are among executive producers of a show based on board game "Identity Crisis.".

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: Celebrity Name Game

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.desc: This light-hearted police drama follows a sheltered deaf woman who is about to start her first real job with the FBI. But after Xiao's maid and sole confidant, Viola (Talia Shire), reveals her wish to undergo a week-long Buddhist funeral rite, the younger Xiaos -- including plastic surgeon Alexander (Russell Wong) and lesbian actress Meimei (Steph Song) -- have seven days to come to terms with her death, and each other.

programme.desc: Just after a jury finds Ann Gray (Maureen O'Sullivan) guilty of murder, the car carrying her to prison crashes into another auto. Tony and Ann are pursued by the police and by Smiley Gordon (Louis Calhern), a mob boss who engineered Ann's escape thinking that she can lead him to a $250,000 stash.

programme.title: Young Man With Ideas
programme.desc: Maxwell Webster practices law in Montana, where he lives a staid existence with his wife, Julie, and their kids. Studying to pass the state's bar exam, Maxwell endures numerous hardships while trying to make ends meet, even becoming involved in questionable schemes. When he gets into trouble for being associated with a bookie, Maxwell has to use his legal skills to defend himself.

programme.title: Never the Twain Shall Meet

programme.title: Please Believe Me

A gambler in debt, Terence Keath (Robert Walker), pursues her. But so does another bachelor on the hunt, playboy Jeremy Taylor (Peter Lawford), who is traveling with his lawyer, Matthew Kinston (Mark Stevens), to whom Kirbe is most attracted. Unfortunately for her, he thinks she's running a scam.

programme.title: The Law in Her Hands
programme.desc: A defense lawyer (Margaret Lindsay) sets her career goals aside to marry a district attorney (Warren Hull).

programme.title: Just This Once
programme.desc: Mark MacLene (Peter Lawford) is a millionaire playboy, but he won't be one much longer if he keeps blowing through his inheritance. In an effort to control his spending, Mark's executor, Judge Samuel Coulter (Lewis Stone), hires lawyer Lucy Duncan (Janet Leigh) to watch over Mark. The two are even forced to live together, much to the dismay of Lucy's boyfriend, Tom (Richard Anderson). At first Mark tries to ditch Lucy and her frugal ways, but soon he finds himself falling for her.

programme.title: The Reformer and the Redhead

As such, they believe that all animals should be treated with kindness, which conflicts with the views of a powerful and crooked political boss (Ray Collins). When the boss has Maguire fired due to this difference, Kathleen springs into action by contacting an attorney and mayoral hopeful (Dick Powell) for help in saving her father's job.

programme.title: Adam's Rib

programme.title: The Gene Krupa Story
programme.desc: This musical biopic is based on the life of Gene Krupa (Sal Mineo), the famed jazz drummer. His Catholic parents want him to be a priest, but Krupa rebels and moves away to make it as a musician in New York City, along with his friend Eddie (James Darren). He eventually falls for a girl, Ethel (Susan Kohner). But the seductions of other women, drugs and fame -- plus a lack of a formal music education -- put a strain on his personal and professional life, and Krupa must re-examine his goals.

programme.title: Cabin in the Sky

He awakens, remembering nothing and struggles to do right by his devout wife, Petunia (Ethel Waters), while an angel known as the General (Kenneth Spencer) and the devil's son, Lucifer Jr. (Rex Ingram), fight for his soul.

programme.title: Reet, Petite and Gone

As Calloway and his band prepare for their maiden performance at the Brass Hat, the vengeful Minnie asks Boss Mason (George Wiltshire) -- the thuggish owner of a competing club -- to put a hit on her man.

Still asleep when the plane sets down, Maria is taken in by the pilot, Eddie (Robert Cummings). When Maria wakes up and meets Edward, sparks fly -- but her royal lineage could complicate matters.

programme.title: Marie Antoinette
programme.desc: The young Austrian princess Marie Antoinette (Norma Shearer) is arranged to marry Louis XVI (Robert Morley), future king of France, in a politically advantageous marriage for the rival countries. The opulent Marie indulges in various whims and flirtations, including Count Axel (Tyrone Power). When Louis XV (John Barrymore) passes and Louis XVI ascends the French throne, his queen's extravagant lifestyle earns the hatred of the French people, who despise her Austrian heritage.

programme.title: The Swan
programme.desc: Prince Albert, who is scouring Europe for a wife, arrives in a tiny town to visit a banished family of nobles. programme.title: Southern Fried Fitness
programme.desc: The adjective "southern-fried" usually indicates something unhealthy. So what's up with the title of this show? Isn't "Southern Fried Fitness" an oxymoron? Not when Louisiana-born culinary entrepreneur Robin Shea is involved. Her goal is to teach people about what she calls the Southern Fried Fitness Lifestyle, which features an 80-20 split -- living a healthy lifestyle 80 percent of the time and enjoying guilt-free Southern indulgences -- even fried foods -- the remaining 20 percent. Shea sees it as the perfect blend of Southerners taking pride in their heritage while forming a new commitment to a healthier, balanced lifestyle.

programme.desc: Dieciocho villanos icónicos compiten por el título de "El Emperador de los Villanos" y 200 mil dólares. Entre desafíos, inmunidades, alianzas y traiciones, solo uno alcanza la cima.

programme.title: Sin senos sí hay paraíso
programme.desc: Una chica busca redimir a su familia del mundo de la violencia y la prostitución que les ha traído tanto dolor y miseria, y decide tener éxito en la vida sin tener que recurrir a la cirugía plástica o caer en la tentación del dinero fácil.
